name: claude-telegram-fleet
description: Claude Code Telegram: the always-on upgrade for the official Telegram channel. Live streaming, voice notes, structured replies, a self-healing watchdog, reboot-surviving restore, and an N-bot fleet on one brain.

plugins.name: telegram-fleet
plugins.description: Hooks, skills, and slash commands that upgrade the official Telegram channel plugin: live progress streaming, guaranteed acks and replies, enforced numbered-TLDR replies, voice-note prompts, and /fresh /resume /model /esc /opus /fable /context /usage from Telegram. Pairs with an installer for the watchdog and snapshot/restore daemon layer.
